proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s T X hT _
  constructor
  · intro h Q hQ hQs
    exact h.eq_of_mem_of_mem hQs hQ
  · intro h
    have hsec := h (s.secondInter T (X -ᵥ T)) (s.secondInter_vsub_mem_affineSpan T X) ((EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.secondInter_mem (X -ᵥ T)).mpr hT)
    have hin : inner ℝ (X -ᵥ T) (T -ᵥ s.center) = 0 := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.secondInter_eq_self_iff.mp hsec
    refine ⟨hT, left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T X, ?_⟩
    rw [affineSpan_le]
    intro p hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl
    · exact EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.self_mem_orthRadius s _
    · exact EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_left.mpr hin
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (T X : P), T ∈ s → X ≠ T → (s.IsTangentAt T line[ℝ, T, X] ↔ ∀ Q ∈ line[ℝ, T, X], Q ∈ s → Q = T)
